itemized.notes: THE PAGES ARE OUT OF ORDER in the PDF: p1 cover, p2 Schedule A (hand-numbered 'Page 1 of 3'), p3 Schedule B ('Page 2 of 3'), p4 Summary Page ('Page 3 of 3') - the Summary Page is NOT on PDF page 2 here. Both schedules are genuinely EMPTY, not unread: the filer drew a single long vertical squiggle down the whole Amount column of each grid to void it and wrote a slashed-zero in the SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells (and in every Column A and Column B cell of the Summary Page). Per the repo zero-glyph ruling the slashed zero IS 0, so this is a real zero-activity filing, not a gap. Zero rows on both sides is the honest transcription.
